properties.NAME: NCA 6
properties.CHANGE: Non-County Area 6 was created in the Upper Peninsula of present Michigan when Wisconsin Territory was created from Michigan Territory, and BROWN (Wis.) and CRAWFORD (Wis.) were eliminated from Michigan Territory.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat., vol. 5, ch. 54 [1836], sec. 1/p. 10; Terr. Papers U.S., 27:41-52)
